snippet.title: Pack my LunchBox: Showtime — Official DLC Trailer (Cozy Puzzle Game)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for "Pack my LunchBox: Showtime" — a cozy expansion DLC dedicated to the magical atmosphere of cinema and your favorite movie snacks! 🎬✨

Sweet popcorn or cheesy nachos? Crispy french fries or a cold soda? Forget homemade lunches: now you are assembling orders for ultimate movie nights! Read the customer cards carefully, check the brand-new Movie Almanac for special combo recipes, and avoid any unwanted ingredients.

🎮 Play the Free Demo & Get the DLC on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457220/Pack_my_LunchBox_Showtime/
🚀 OUT NOW!
🌟 Explore our full collection: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45978844

DLC Features:
🍿 Movie Menu: 70 brand-new, delicious cinema snack items;
🧠 70 Fresh Levels: Relaxing logic puzzles that follow specific customer cravings;
📖 Combo Mechanic: Use the new Movie Almanac to look up recipes for special orders;
🎨 Relax Mode: Fill up the trays exactly the way you want without any rules;
💖 The perfect cozy gameplay to unwind and enjoy the cinema vibes.

Subscribe for more updates, trailers, and upcoming cozy releases!
📬 Contact us: owlshowls.steam@gmail.com
